abstract: The main aim of our project is to address the problem of inherent complexity associated with insurance policy documents, which are generally described by complex legal terminologies, numerous policy conditions, and complex benefits tables. The complexity associated with insurance policy documents is considered a major obstacle in assisting the policyholders in understanding the insurance policies they have purchased and creates a huge workload for insurance agents in handling the day-to-day policy-related queries. The main aim of the current study is to develop an "AI Insurance Agent" for the automatic interpretation of insurance policy documents. The methodology of the current study includes the implementation of a hybrid Artificial Intelligence model in which Typhoon OCR is implemented for the accurate extraction of text and data from the tables in the insurance policy documents in various formats such as PDF, JPG, and PNG. Furthermore, the current study has implemented Typhoon 2.5 30B Large Language Model for the accurate reasoning and analysis of the data extracted from the insurance policy documents. The implementation of the Retrieval-Augmented Generation of text model has also ensured the accurate answers provided by the system based on the insurance policy documents uploaded by the user, thus eliminating the possibility of AI hallucinations.

domain.evidence: The whole report addresses insurance policy documents, insurance agents, and insurance customers, and the system was tested with a real insurance policy booklet.

abstract: iRC - NewsGen is a web-based admin dashboard designed to streamline the news production workflow for small editorial teams. The system integrates n8n workflow automation with the Google Gemini AI API to handle the repetitive stages of news production, including web scraping, article drafting, keyword extraction, and bilingual translation between Thai and English. The platform is configured to generate 10 articles per week, which are then presented to editors through a centralized dashboard for review and approval. Once an editor verifies an article, it can be published directly to a Sanity content database with a single action.

abstract: This project presents the development of Pro Sales, a web-based system designed to improve sales productivity for the Japanese Sales Team at Adecco, a global recruitment and human resources company operating in Thailand. The system aims to support sales representatives in managing prospect companies, organizing outreach activities, and identifying potential clients more efficiently through a centralized platform. Another objective of the project is to organize and centralize the sales team's company database, which was previously stored across multiple Excel files. The system consolidates these datasets into a structured relational database while ensuring that all information is stored locally within the organization to address data privacy concerns. Pro Sales is developed using modern web technologies, including React, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, to provide an efficient and scalable solution for managing sales data and improving overall sales operations.

domain.evidence: The project improves sales productivity for the Japanese Sales Team at Adecco, a global recruitment and human resources company, and scrapes competitor recruitment platforms for leads.

abstract: Daily transportation often faces challenges such as traffic congestion, high travel costs, and environmental pollution. Many individuals travel to similar destinations using separate vehicles, which leads to inefficient transportation and increased traffic. Hop-On RideShare is a ride-sharing platform designed to connect users who are traveling in the same direction. The application allows users to post rides, view available rides, and join shared trips easily through a mobile application. By enabling users to share rides, the system helps reduce travel costs, decrease traffic congestion, and promote eco-friendly transportation. The application integrates features such as ride management, real-time map navigation, and communication between users. It is developed using Android technologies with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, supported by MongoDB and Google Maps APIs for location and routing services.

canonical_title: Game Realism through Graphics and Physics
abstract: The development of visually realistic virtual environments has become an important objective in modern computer graphics and game development. Game engines such as Unreal Engine 5 provide advanced technologies for real-time rendering and physics simulation, enabling developers to create highly immersive environments. However, achieving high levels of realism in real-time applications introduces significant computational challenges. Rendering systems that simulate realistic lighting behavior require substantial GPU resources, while physics simulation systems require CPU processing power. Because real-time applications must maintain stable frame rates, rendering and physics systems must operate within strict performance constraints. Indoor environments present additional challenges because lighting reflections and object interactions occur within confined spaces. Small visual artifacts or unstable physics behavior can significantly reduce perceived realism. Developers must therefore carefully balance rendering quality and physics precision to achieve both visual fidelity and performance stability. This project investigates the interaction between rendering and physics subsystems in Unreal Engine 5 and proposes a performance-aware framework for enhancing indoor scene realism. The study analyzes how rendering technologies such as Lumen global illumination and physics systems such as the Chaos physics engine compete for computational resources within a fixed frame-time budget. The results suggest that improvements in lighting coherence often produce greater perceptual realism benefits than marginal increases in physics precision in typical indoor scenes. Based on this observation, a system-level framework is proposed that coordinates rendering and physics parameters to optimize realism while maintaining real-time performance.

technology.evidence: Physics systems such as the Chaos physics engine are analyzed against rendering load, and collision stability is one of the measured metrics.
